messages:
Liam: Hey London crew  anyone know a good spot around King's Cross or Shoreditch for a casual team lunch? Some folks arriving from Bristol, want something walkable from the office and tube, outdoor/covered seating would be ace.

Hana: Dishoom near King's Cross is always reliable but can be busy. If you want more casual, Caravan has a big space and decent veg options.

Priyanka: +1 Caravan. Also check Vinoteca for calmer vibe but smaller tables.

Tom: Shoreditch escape: Dishoom Shoreditch or Smokestak if you want BBQ vibes (but not the best for vegetarians).

marco (intern): Don't sleep on Papi (that little Peruvian spot)  good for groups and cheap cocktails.

Liam: Is there anything that does fixed-price menus for groups? Makes expense reporting easier.

Hana: Caravan sometimes does group menus if you call ahead. Dishoom can do a set menu for groups too (call the reservations).

Priyanka: quick poll? lunchbot, can you run a 90s poll: Caravan / Dishoom KX / Papi?

lunchbot: Poll created by Priyanka  React to vote: Caravan / Dishoom KX / Papi

Tom: Caravan for me  big space and veg options.

marco (intern): Caravan! also they have good coffee for the bleary-eyed. :coffee:

Priyanka: Dishoom KX if we want iconic place for out-of-towners.

Hana: Caravan wins my vote.

lunchbot: Poll results  Caravan: 3 votes, Dishoom KX: 1 vote, Papi: 1 vote.

Liam: Caravan it is. I can ring and see about a set menu + covered seating. Who's coming: @Hana @Priyanka @Tom @marco?

marco (intern): In! I can grab a list of dietary prefs and DM.

Priyanka: Count me in. I can collect receipts and do the expense report template if needed.

Hana: I'll be there. If Caravan can't do it, second choice Dishoom.

Liam: Thanks team, will confirm time (prob 12:30) and post booking here. :thumbsup:
